fusions.name: Chewed-Point Javelin
fusions.desc: Hurls a stick you chewed to a point, dealing 32 damage to the first enemy it meets, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Prodding Stick
fusions.desc: Jabs a stick at an enemy up to 4 tiles away for 5 damage, growing the further it reaches, up to 1.4 times at full reach.

fusions.name: Pole Vault
fusions.desc: Plants a long stick and vaults 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you land.

fusions.name: Sharpened Habit
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
